hypothesis: The four-trainable-parameter factual memory-admission gate will beat the strongest valid 256-float conventional baseline, when the exact PR177 ring control is substituted without modifying the original P68 implementation or reusing any previously scored OOD stream.

source.family: A fresh synthetic development cohort with per-world independent 16-dimensional orthogonal keys, continuous 16-dimensional action consequences and randomly interleaved repeated target events with singleton distractors. This is not a physically authenticated or distinct scientific source family.
source.generation: Start from a new per-split torch.Generator; draw orthogonal basis, 8 keys, independent tanh effects, normalized uniformly random distractor keys/effects, shuffle all factual events per world, draw one executed simulated final query after sequence; query/effect/relevance never sent to historical write interface. OOD effect amplitude factor 1.2, other splits 1.0
source.reused_sources: NONE; P65, P66, P67, P68, other P69 OOD and sources are consumed and MUST NOT be regenerated for tuning or novel evaluation
source.negative: orthogonal-to-target-subspace distractors at seed 1000119 with unchanged target stream comparator; require target predictions insensitive to orthogonal distractor.

arms.learned: Use exact unchanged P68 WriteGate and train functions, seed theta separately and select best checkpoints on VALIDATION only; all runs share the same sample-index schedule but have distinct initializations.
arms.ring: Use `stream` and `predict` from exact PR177 experiments/p69_ring_cache.py imported by path; no alternative cyclic-cache implementation, no copy-pasted logic or independent pointer.
arms.wrong_credit: Separately train three 4-param gates on independent historical invalid action-credit keys, same FIT/VAL and batch schedule; compare OOD once

training.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation MSE only, no OOD selection

controls.stop_before_ood_if: Any malformed factual stream, source-index shortcut, nonfinite outputs, comparator memory budget >256, missing or extra ring state, cache cold restore failure, invalid baseline validation, unqualified learned gate seed, nonindependent gate initialization or missing source custody
controls.source_leakage: For FIT,VAL and OOD-DEV: quartile max prevalence departure<=0.05; held-out index-only balanced accuracy<=0.55; historical write accepts exactly action and observed effect.
controls.memory: For each world exactly 256 float32 persistent state scalars for ring keys/effects, frequency keys/effects and learned matrix; ring carries no time/pointer except marker encoded in key.
controls.negative: Ring >8 misses truly round-robin, hit does not advance cursor; all ring carried state is revalidated; chunked/cold-restored state and readout bitwise equal full run; wrong-credit MSE>=1.2x correct in every seed; orthogonal target output max change<=1e-5.
controls.competence: Before OOD scoring, frequency, PR177 ring and all-write MSE on full validation worlds each <=0.75*zero MSE; all 3 learned gate best-validation MSE <=0.85*zero. On any failure, preserve FAIL and NO OOD MSE.
controls.primary: One OOD-DEV outcome scoring after all preregistered VAL checks: each gate OOD MSE <=0.9*strongest eligible conventional comparator (ring, frequency, all-write, zero) on identical worlds, and paired 2000-bootstrap resamples with seed 1000401 95% lower relative improvement bound>0. All three independent gate initializations must pass.
controls.process_cost: Report exact CPU runtime and per-arm fit timings; track float state and trainable parameters; full whole-process FLOP equality and peak memory not established.
controls.strict: Only DEV_PASS_ALL_CONTROLS if all tests, source audits, baseline competency, three gate successes, all negative controls and source custody PASS; else DEV_FAIL, preserve all outcomes.

authority.permitted: Isolated synthetic DEV experiment and additive tests/receipts only, separate branch and draft PR stacked on PR177; no model/science first-use, no merges or promotions.
